candidate_path_gate: candidate audit must contain phase=runtime_invocation, qk_head_dim=288, v_head_dim=256, sliding_window_size=1024, and removed_operations=[k.clone,v.clone]
source_justification: Pinned v0.5.13 TritonAttnBackend.forward_extend calls set_kv_buffer before extend_attention_fwd. With FP8 KV cache, set_kv_buffer descales K/V in place, so the backend protects the tensors with k.clone() and v.clone() before _fwd_kernel consumes them. For local sliding layers only, enqueueing the same cache commit after extend_attention_fwd preserves CUDA-stream dependence and exact attention inputs while eliminating two full BF16 tensor clones. It does not gather KV, alter heads/model geometry, substitute a backend, or tune KV splits/flags.
